question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Similar
solution:
The correct answer is **'Alike'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Similar** means like somebody/something but not exactly the same.

 ** • Example-** *They had **similar** experiences growing up, even though they came from vastly different backgrounds.*

 
• Marked option **Alike** means in the same manner, form, or degree.

 ** • Example- ***The two pendants are very much **alike.***

 
• So, it is clear that the most appropriate synonym for **'Similar'** is **'Alike'.**

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Alien** means a creature that comes from another planet.
 
• **Several** means more than two but not very many; a few.
 
• **Equal** means the same in size, amount, value, number, level, etc.
